description: Build a well-structured prompt to paste into an AI chatbot or image generator. Give the task plus any of: the role the AI should take, background, audience, tone, format, length, things to avoid, an example of good output, and material to work on (for summarise, analyse and code tasks). taskType image switches to style, lighting, composition and aspect ratio instead. target formats the prompt for 'chatgpt' (Markdown headings, the task repeated after long material, as OpenAI's guidance suggests), 'claude' (XML tags with long material first and the task last, as Anthropic recommends), 'gemini' (Markdown with the question after the context, as Google recommends) or 'any'. Returns the prompt, a checklist of which parts are present, vague words found, and the word count with a rough token estimate (characters divided by 4). Nothing is sent to any AI. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/ai-prompt-builder/

askQuestions.description: Ask the AI to ask clarifying questions before it starts

composition.description: Composition and camera, e.g. 'close-up, low angle' (image tasks only)

context.description: Background the AI needs: the situation, facts and figures

example.description: A short example of what good output looks like

explainReasoning.description: Ask the AI to explain its main choices after answering

language.description: Programming language and tools (code tasks only)

length.description: Length: one sentence, one short paragraph, under 100/250/500 words, about 1,000 words, or as long as it needs

material.description: Text, data or code to work on (used for summarise, analyse and code)

role.description: Who the AI should be, e.g. 'A UK consumer rights adviser'

target.description: Which AI to format the prompt for; default any (ignored for images)

task.description: What the AI should do (for images: what the image should show)
